title: Depth Probe

story.briefing: How far does the lattice reach? The deepest junction sets how much cable the crew has to carry.
story.success: Depth reported. The crew packs exactly enough cable.

description: Return the depth of a binary tree — the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to any leaf. A single node is depth 1. An empty tree is depth 0. A tree is given as an array where the node at index i has its left child at index 2i+1 and its right child at index 2i+2. A null entry means there is no node there, and nothing exists beneath it. An empty array is an empty tree.

examples.explanation: One branch is missing; depth follows the longer side.

hints: A node depth is one more than the deeper of its two subtrees. That sentence is the whole solution.
An absent subtree contributes 0, not 1. Getting that base case wrong makes every leaf report one level too deep.
Write a helper on an index: return 0 if the index is out of range or the entry is null, otherwise return 1 plus the larger of the two child results.
